normal_discriminating_test.name: CURRENT_HEAD_ARITHMETIC_EXPRESSION_ADMISSION
normal_discriminating_test.source: module clay.entityos.active_go; fn twice(x : Int) -> Int { return x + x }; fn main() -> Int { return twice(21) }
normal_discriminating_test.observed_error: nominal typechecker rejected executable IR: UNSUPPORTED_EXPRESSION:twice:AST node Arith not admitted by typechecker v1
normal_discriminating_test.secondary_observation: The frozen CLI surfaces this expected semantic rejection as an unhandled exception/traceback rather than a bounded diagnostic.
normal_discriminating_test.interpretation: Executable coverage remains deliberately narrow; arithmetic expressions are not yet admitted by the current nominal typechecker. This is a concrete CM-03/CM-04 coverage obligation, not by itself the highest release blocker.

unusual_experiment.name: UNLINKED_EXECUTABLE_PROC_FD_STARTUP
unusual_experiment.intervention: Copy the exact one-file ELF into an isolated temp directory, open it, unlink the pathname, then exec the still-open file through /proc/self/fd/<fd>.
unusual_experiment.predicted_if_path_independent: Embedded one-file runtime starts and produces the same self-test result.
unusual_experiment.predicted_if_path_backed_startup_require: Bootloader fails before EntityOS self-test because the embedded package cannot be reopened by executable path.
unusual_experiment.observed_error: Could not load PyInstaller's embedded PKG archive from the executable
unusual_experiment.derived_invariant: The current PyInstaller one-file carrier requires a stable path-backed executable during startup; do not unlink/replace the running path before bootloader package acquisition completes.
unusual_experiment.rollback: Isolated temporary copy only; no repository, accepted runner or user state was modified.

current_parallel_evidence.note: Packaging/reproducibility is stronger than whole-machine/runtime acceptance; SQLite provenance/productive-path failures remain fail-closed evidence.

grf_collapse.observed: Current-head EntityOS is a reproducible executable carrier with passing exact self-test and canonical VM/process path, but whole-machine acceptance is explicitly false.
grf_collapse.retained_hypothesis: Keep the one-file carrier and expand canonical semantics through the existing ClayCode -> TypedIR -> single ClayVM -> ClayOS path.
grf_collapse.counter_reality: A reproducible one-file shell can conceal narrow language/value/effect coverage and host/storage dependencies.

release_blocker.exact_blocking_invariant: Whole-machine acceptance remains false: canonical Clay Bytes/Buffer ownership+lifetime and String/argv/effect-signature semantics plus broader typed runtime/network/media/storage paths are not yet admitted end-to-end; productive SQLite provenance/path gates also remain fail-closed.
release_blocker.next_executable_step: Implement and gate the smallest canonical String/Bytes/argv value plus effect-signature slice through TypedIR and the single ClayVM into the existing capability-gated ClayOS process component, then rebuild/retest exact one-file EntityOS; separately satisfy the productive SQLite trust/provenance gate with privileged runner remediation or equivalent accepted proof.
